evals.prompt: Here's the full SKILL.md for our new skilldrop skill `vendor-risk-screen` (a gate skill that reads a vendor security questionnaire and emits PROCEED, REVISE, or BLOCKED; its quality bar says it must never pass a vendor that has no SOC 2 report or equivalent, and must never invent certifications not in the questionnaire). [SKILL.md pasted below] Generate the eval cases for its evals/ folder.
assertions: Produces 8 to 12 cases, each with id, trigger, expected_shape, must_not_include, verdict_class, and notes
Every trigger is a realistic input a user would paste (e.g. a specific questionnaire excerpt), not 'run this skill'
Every expected_shape item is checkable — it names a specific section, field, or behavior, not 'output is good'
At least 2 cases test the quality bar's failure modes, including a vendor with no SOC 2 report that must not get PROCEED
Because the skill is a gate, verdict_class values come from contracts/terminals.json and at least one case expects revise or blocked
At least one must_not_include entry forbids certifications or facts not present in the input questionnaire
A 3 to 5 sentence eval strategy note follows the JSON, naming the most important case and what a regression on it would mean
Ends with the placement reminder for packs/<pack>/skills/vendor-risk-screen/evals/ and running python3 validate.py
